svg.aria-label: An agent supplies an inline C# method body or a project-relative script. dotcraft-unity generates an entry method, compiles it with Roslyn against Unity-loaded assemblies, and caches the executable by source hash. The method runs on Unity's main thread, where it can inspect or modify Editor state. A normalized return value, Console logs, diagnostics, and duration come back as one structured result.
svg.title: C# automation inside Unity

g.text: Editor or Play Mode, with optional arguments
inline method body or project-relative script
Unity assemblies referenced · executable cached by source hash
generated entry method calls Unity APIs
return value · Console logs · diagnostics · duration
